name: Claim-deadline supply stabilization
hypothesis: Buy a reclaim after the claim deadline and verified recipient inflows decline while external demand persists.
spec: Setup: A known distribution window ending may reduce new sell inventory. Entry: Buy a reclaim after the claim deadline and verified recipient inflows decline while external demand persists. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit if new distribution resumes or the reclaim fails. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
